stemMd: A healthy person becomes dehydrated. Increased antidiuretic hormone generally causes which response in the kidney?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Loss of all sodium pumps in the nephron

options.label: D
options.textMd: Greater water loss in a larger volume of dilute urine

options.label: E
options.textMd: Greater water reabsorption in the collecting ducts

explanationMd: ADH increases collecting-duct water permeability, allowing more water to return to the body along the osmotic gradient. This tends to reduce urine volume and increase its concentration.

distractorRationale.b: ADH mainly regulates water permeability, not absolute shutdown.
distractorRationale.a: ADH does not remove all transport proteins.
distractorRationale.c: ADH does not catalyse this conversion.
